summary: Task 1 (Deposit Screenshot Upload + Google Vision OCR + Duplicate-UTR fraud flag) verified end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass against the public URL — (1) deposit without screenshot returns PENDING with has_screenshot=false, ocr=null, duplicate_utr=false; (2) deposit WITH a tiny PNG returns PENDING, has_screenshot=true, screenshot_path set, ocr present with status='unavailable' and match.overall='unknown' (correct — GOOGLE_CLOUD_VISION_API_KEY is intentionally unset); (3) non-image PDF as screenshot correctly returns 415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE; (4) duplicate-UTR flag works: after admin CONFIRMS a deposit with reference X, a NEW deposit with the same reference X comes back with duplicate_utr=true while a fresh unique reference stays duplicate_utr=false; (5) admin1 (target admin), manager1 (chain owner), and superadmin can all GET /api/admin/deposits/{id}/screenshot returning 200 with image/* content-type and non-empty bytes; (6) 404 returned when the deposit has no screenshot; (7) SCOPE ISOLATION verified with a fresh 2nd admin under manager1 with its own player — admin1 gets 404 for that other admin's screenshot, while the owning admin, manager, and super all get 200; (8) confirm regression: coins credited by exactly amount_inr and second confirm returns 400 with no double-credit; (9) reject regression works. Frontend: Player wallet Add-Coins modal (data-testid=add-coins-modal) shows the 'Attach payment screenshot (optional)' button (deposit-screenshot-add), file picker input (deposit-screenshot-input) accepts an image, preview panel (deposit-screenshot-preview) appears with remove button (deposit-screenshot-remove), submit sends multipart request and shows the 'Top-up request sent' success toast, then the deposit history (deposit-history) refreshes. Admin console /console → Deposits tab shows 4 screenshot thumbnails (screenshot-thumb-{id}), 4 OcrPanel components (ocr-panel) each with ocr-verdict text reading exactly 'OCR unavailable — review manually' (correct expected state), 2 amber duplicate banners (deposit-duplicate-{id}) on the reused-reference rows, and clicking a thumbnail opens the full-size Payment screenshot modal (screenshot-modal-{id}).
critical_code_review_comments: wallet.py deposit-request: 8 MB size check happens AFTER await screenshot.read() — a malicious client sending a 100 MB body still consumes memory before we reject. Consider streaming with a size guard or relying on Starlette's max_request_size at ingress. Low severity for MVP.

deposit_service.create_deposit_request never fails the request if storage_service.put_object raises — it just logs and continues. That is intentional (documented in the code) but the returned document then has has_screenshot=false while the player believes their image was attached. Consider surfacing a 'screenshot_upload_failed' flag so the Admin knows to ask again.
ocr_service.get_ocr_provider is instantiated per-request (fine) but reads env at each call — good for zero-restart key rotation, but note there is no async lock protecting concurrent init.

Duplicate-UTR check compares reference_note exactly (case-sensitive). Real UTRs are alphanumeric so this is fine, but the frontend does .trim() and no case-normalize — consistent, so match is exact. Consider normalizing to upper+strip for both write and lookup to be tolerant.

admin.py continues to grow (>690 lines with the new screenshot endpoint) — the earlier code-review recommendation to split into feature routers (managers, admins, deposits, settlements, recharges) still stands.

storage_service.STORAGE_BASE uses `or` fallback correctly (platform sometimes sends empty string) — good. _storage_key is module-global and not thread-safe, but every call goes through asyncio.to_thread so effectively serialized per-worker; retry-on-404 pattern is clean.
OcrPanel gracefully renders 3 states (match/review/unknown) and hides the field-level checks when verdict is 'unknown' — good UX for the 'OCR unavailable' case.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Task 1 testids verified: deposit-screenshot-add/input/preview/remove, screenshot-thumb-*, ocr-panel, ocr-verdict, deposit-duplicate-*, screenshot-modal-*)

context_for_next_testing_agent: POST /api/wallet/deposit-request is now multipart/form-data — send amount_inr + reference_note as form fields (requests: data=...) and 'screenshot' as a file (requests: files=...). Old tests in test_royal11_deposits_referrals.py still send json= and will 422 against the new signature; if a previous suite is re-run, migrate those calls to data=. OCR verdict 'unavailable'/'unknown' is CORRECT — do not report it as a bug unless GOOGLE_CLOUD_VISION_API_KEY has actually been set in backend/.env. Screenshot bytes stream through /api/admin/deposits/{id}/screenshot with Authorization header — frontend loads it as a blob (not ).
